notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Fixes, Balance & QoL Improvements
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, and thank you for all the amazing feedback and support during the festival! ❤️[/p][p]I’ve just updated the [b]Agecraft[/b] demo to make the experience smoother and more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔹 What’s new:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several noticeable bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the balance for a smoother start.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra helper elements to improve control and orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a few [b]QoL improvements[/b] - small changes that make the game more comfortable to play.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]✨ What is QoL?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p]“Quality of Life” improvements are little tweaks that don’t change the core gameplay, but make everything feel better. Examples include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]clearer tooltips;[/p][/*][*][p]improved hotkeys;[/p][/*][*][p]quicker access to essential actions;[/p][/*][*][p]better visibility for resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Try out the updated demo and let us know what you think![/p][p]👉 And if you haven’t yet, don’t forget to add [b]Agecraft[/b] to your Wishlist - it really helps a lot 🏗️[/p]

notes.title: Agecraft Debuts at the Ukrainian Games Festival with a Free Demo!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce that Agecraft is joining the Ukrainian Games Festival — and it’s bringing a free playable demo!

Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building simulator where you lead your civilization through 7 eras — from the Stone Age to the future. Build settlements, develop the economy, take care of your people, and unlock new technologies.

🎮 What’s new?
- Free demo available during the festival!
- Try the core mechanics of building, logistics, and survival.
- Watch your civilization evolve over time.

🗓 When?
The demo will be available throughout the Ukrainian Games Festival. Don’t miss your chance to play early!

💡 Add Agecraft to your wishlist and share your feedback on the demo — it will help us make the game even better.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554890/4dd643add65f11979b89f09d439da7f859be0d28.png"][/img][/p]
